objective: Implement the deterministic architecture adviser core: a strict requirements schema (workload = list of Requirement items each with category, optional capabilities, quantified demands with Decimal amounts, and constraints; rejects URLs; bounded), a published-catalogue selection layer (only Z0_TRUE_FREE offers may enter a guaranteed-$0 architecture; Z3_SELF_HOSTED_BUILDING_BLOCK offers held for the self-hosting fallback; candidate/discovery tables never read), exact-Decimal quota fit/headroom math (fails closed on unknown/unmatched units), deterministic portability/lock-in/exit-plan derivation, an orchestrator that produces either a guaranteed-$0 Z0 architecture or, when impossible, follows the STRICT order blocking-explanation -> demand-reduction -> recalculation -> self-hosting (with Z1/Z2 only in a separate clearly-marked 'not $0' section), and a templated evidence-backed explanation engine (quota math + Z0-safety reasons + portability/lock-in/exit-plan per component + a whole-architecture $0 proof). Exposed at a SEPARATE, STATELESS POST /adviser/recommend (read-only DB session, nothing persisted/logged, no LLM, no URLs). A JSON evaluation corpus (tests/fixtures/adviser/<case>/{input.json,expected.json}) plus a corpus-runner asserts the deterministic output with ALL LLM PROVIDERS DISABLED.
scope: apps/api/app/read_api/normalize.py: ADD an exact-Decimal normalization path (a NormalizedDecimal dataclass + normalize_amount_decimal + a Decimal comparable helper) that reuses the existing unit tables. The existing float normalize_amount / NormalizedAmount / comparable are left untouched so every S1 compare test stays green.
apps/api/app/adviser/__init__.py (new): package marker + a small public surface.

apps/api/app/adviser/schema.py (new): strict Pydantic requirements model (extra=forbid, bounded lengths/list sizes, Decimal demand amounts > 0, category restricted to the 14 canonical slugs, a reusable validator that rejects URL/host-like free text). Product-fixed priorities are a code constant, not user input.

apps/api/app/adviser/select.py (new): read-only gathering of PUBLISHED offers into Z0 candidates (persisted zero_cost_class == Z0_TRUE_FREE AND classify engine agrees; contradiction -> excluded/fail closed) and a held set of Z3 self-hostable building blocks. Eager-loads service->provider, versions->quotas, versions->evidence, and region availability. Never queries candidate/discovery_candidate.

apps/api/app/adviser/quota_math.py (new): exact-Decimal fit/headroom. Per demand, finds a metric-matched, period-compatible quota in the offer, normalizes both sides to a canonical Decimal in the same dimension (reusing normalize.py's Decimal path), and reports covered iff headroom = quota_amount - demand_amount >= 0. Any missing/unmatched metric, unknown unit, dimension mismatch, or incompatible period FAILS CLOSED ('cannot guarantee') with a note; never a guessed conversion.

apps/api/app/adviser/portability.py (new): deterministic portability score in [0,1] + label (high/medium/low) + lock-in label + exit-plan lines, derived purely from Service.deployment_model + Service.portability_traits (+ provider). Honest low/uncertain result when data is absent (never fabricated certainty).

apps/api/app/adviser/recommend.py (new): the orchestrator. Category-matched, constraint-filtered (commercial_use/personal_use/region/residency), all-demands-covered Z0 selection with a stable TOTAL ordering (tightest-headroom, then confidence label, then portability, then provider slug, then offer id) so identical inputs always yield an identical recommendation. When every requirement fits -> a guaranteed-$0 architecture + $0 proof. When a requirement has no fitting Z0 offer -> the STRICT impossible order: (a) explain the blocking requirement (which metric/constraint blocks $0, evidence-backed), (b) REDUCTION (deterministically compute the reduced demand that fits the best available Z0 headroom), (c) RECALCULATION (re-run selection under the reduced demand and show the resulting Z0 architecture), (d) SELF-HOSTING (Z3 building blocks on Z0 hosting). Z1/Z2 options appear ONLY in a separate, clearly-marked 'not $0' section, NEVER in the recommendation/impossible path.

apps/api/app/adviser/explain.py (new): templated, deterministic, evidence-backed explanation assembly (per-component quota math + Z0-safety reasons + portability/lock-in/exit-plan + evidence linkage, and the whole-architecture $0 proof). Sourced from persisted material_facts + Evidence only; never generated/guessed.

apps/api/app/adviser/schemas.py (new): Pydantic response models for the recommendation (architecture components, per-requirement outcomes, the ordered impossible resolution, the separate not-$0 section, and the $0 proof). Exact amounts serialized as strings to preserve Decimal exactness in the payload.

apps/api/app/adviser/router.py (new): POST /adviser/recommend. Body = requirements. Uses the read-only get_session dependency (never commits). STATELESS: nothing persisted or logged; no LLM; no URLs accepted (schema rejects); no DB writes. Malformed input -> 422.
apps/api/app/main.py: mount the new /adviser router alongside the existing /catalogue router.

tests/fixtures/adviser/<case>/{input.json,expected.json} (new): the evaluation corpus. Cases cover satisfiable single- and multi-requirement Z0 architectures; exact quota-math boundary cases (headroom exactly 0); unknown-quota/unit fail-closed; impossible -> reduction -> recalculation -> self-hosting order; and Z1/Z2-only-in-separate-section.

tests/unit/test_adviser_*.py (new): offline deterministic unit tests for schema (URL rejection, bounds, Decimal, category enum), quota_math (exact Decimal, boundary headroom==0, fail-closed matrix), portability (deterministic scores/labels/exit-plan), select (Z0-only + contradiction fail-closed + candidate never touched), recommend (satisfiable, impossible order, Z1/Z2 separation, total-order determinism), explain (evidence-backed templates + $0 proof), a corpus-runner that asserts every fixture's expected output with all LLM providers disabled, the router via TestClient (200 happy path, 422 malformed, URL rejected, GET -> 405, no candidate/discovery field in any response, no persistence), and an import guard that the adviser package imports no LLM/network module.

acceptance_criteria: 1. With ALL LLM providers disabled (the default), the evaluation corpus produces the expected deterministic recommendations (corpus-runner asserts input.json -> expected.json for every case).
2. Quota math is EXACT (Decimal) end-to-end; a boundary case with headroom exactly 0 fits; an unknown/unmatched unit or metric FAILS CLOSED ('cannot guarantee'), never a guessed conversion.

3. Z0 safety holds: only Z0_TRUE_FREE offers (verified by the reused classify engine, persisted class agreeing) ever enter the recommendation/impossible path; a contradictory/unknown offer is never recommended.
4. Portability score/label, lock-in label, and exit-plan explanations are present and correct per component, derived deterministically from deployment_model + portability_traits.

5. Impossible workloads follow reduction -> recalculation -> self-hosting IN THAT ORDER, with the blocking requirement explained first, and Z1/Z2 options only in the separate clearly-marked 'not $0' section (never in the recommendation or impossible path).
6. The endpoint persists/logs nothing, uses a read-only DB session (no commit/no writes), rejects URLs, and runs no LLM; malformed input -> 422; a write verb -> 405.

7. OfferVersion immutability (trg_offer_version_immutable, 23001) and both 0006 separation triggers remain intact and untouched; candidate/discovery_candidate are never read or exposed (guard test present).
8. Multi-provider / multi-option behaviour is proven via clearly-synthetic fixtures (corpus + integration), never published on a normal stack run.
9. Determinism: identical input always yields an identical recommendation (stable total ordering); asserted by the corpus and a dedicated ordering test.
10. No new dependency and no migration: Alembic head stays 0007; requirements-sync + npm audit stay green; the existing float normalize_amount / S1 compare tests stay green.
11. Offline gates green: scripts/test.ps1 exit 0 and scripts/check.ps1 -NodeAudit exit 0 (all 8 gates).

12. Live POST /adviser/recommend returns a correct deterministic recommendation (satisfiable) and the correct reduction->recalculation->self-hosting order (impossible), direct on the API port and through the nginx /api proxy, with LLM disabled.
13. F006 remains passes:false; a fresh-context independent Level 2 evaluator owns any status change.

Only published catalogue data is read; candidate/discovery_candidate are never queried; a guard test asserts those fields never surface.
risks.portability: No new runtime dependency; stdlib decimal only; reuses SQLAlchemy + FastAPI + Pydantic already present. amd64/arm64 unaffected.
risks.zero_cost_safety: Only Z0_TRUE_FREE offers enter a guaranteed-$0 architecture; the reused classify engine confirms each and a persisted/engine disagreement excludes the offer (fail closed). Quota fit is exact Decimal and fails closed on any unknown unit/metric/period. Z1/Z2 appear only in a separate 'not $0' section. 'unknown is better than guessed' throughout.
risks.immutability: Read-only slice: no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE in application code. trg_offer_version_immutable and the two 0006 separation triggers are untouched. Integration tests may INSERT synthetic rows inside a transaction that is rolled back; they never UPDATE/DELETE a version and never commit.
risks.regression: Additive package + one additive router mount + an additive Decimal function in normalize.py. The existing float normalize_amount, the seven /catalogue endpoints, the three F006 slice-1 endpoints, and all existing tests are unchanged.
risks.supply_chain: No new Python or npm runtime dependency; requirements-sync + npm audit stay green; stdlib + already-present deps only.
